recommendation: Do not promote anything from B070 (measurement role; no new candidate). Realistic multi-family exposure in 2025 is small (2+ same-family teams in ~1% of cohorts) and combined attacks are sub-additive overall, so their field cost is <= ~0.002/battle. The one crowd that compounds is several DIFFERENT MOVSW anchor killers (base 0.354); A015's A_t800 recovers +0.19 there (11/0), so if the 2026 field is expected to hold several MOVSW replicators, an 800h A trail (or another MOVSW defense without its no-Zombie cost) is the lever to work on. The coordinator should consider adding a distinct-member MOVSW crowd cohort (cgx+Baltika9+TrojanByte) to the confirmation threat group in place of clone crowds.
